When we talk about climate change, we often focus on the problems and forget about the solutions. There are many ways to help, like increasing recycling, reducing pollution, and finding sustainable alternatives to things like plastic, air conditioning, smartphones, and fast fashion.

Recently, experts from around the world met in Copenhagen to discuss the latest report on climate change. The report showed that climate change is happening everywhere, and we need to work harder to reduce pollution to prevent it from getting worse. The meeting also highlighted the available solutions.

The Sustainia Award, led by Arnold Schwarzenegger, celebrated ten successful sustainability projects used in 84 countries. These projects offered alternatives to negative predictions about the future and showed how sustainability can be achieved in areas like food, fashion, energy, transport, education, and health.

For example, a project in California showed how to make plastic from greenhouse gases at a competitive price. A project in Switzerland improved the recycling of old clothes and shoes, and is now used in over 60 countries. And in Canada, smartphones are being used to make bike-sharing easier.

The Sustainia Award 2014 was given to Wecyclers, a project from Nigeria. Wecyclers helps low-income communities earn money from their waste. They use bicycles to collect and recycle rubbish in Lagos, and families can earn points via text message to exchange for goods.

Recycling companies then buy the sorted waste and turn it into new products like mattresses, pillows, and trash bags. Wecyclers is helping to address the problem of waste in Lagos, where only 40% of rubbish is currently collected. Across Africa, only 46% of waste is collected, according to the

BB King was famous for playing the blues, but he also enjoyed playing different kinds of music and bringing people together. Many people think he was one of the most important blues musicians ever, influencing thousands of other musicians and millions of fans over his 65-year career.

Riley B King was born near Itta Bena, Mississippi, and grew up as an African-American farm worker. He didn’t have many opportunities, but he learned to play the guitar from a friend and sang in a gospel quartet. He moved to Memphis when he was in his early 20s.

Soon, he was playing at a bar in West Memphis, Arkansas, and also worked as a radio DJ. He became known as “The Beale Street Blues Boy,” which was quickly shortened to “BB.” In 1950, he started recording music with Modern Records.

In 1952, he had his first hit song, “Three O’Clock Blues,” which was a new version of an older song. It was number one on the R&B charts for 15 weeks. He had many other successful songs, including “Please Love Me,” “You Upset Me Baby,” and “Sweet Sixteen.” He created a unique style of playing that was both new and connected to the history of the blues. He always admired other musicians, especially T-Bone Walker.

He said he tried to copy T-Bone Walker’s sound, but could never quite manage it. He also liked the music of Blind Lemon Jefferson, Lonnie Johnson, Charlie Christian, and Django Reinhardt.

Kenton Cool is finding it difficult to speak after climbing at high altitudes. He is in Kathmandu, Nepal, after flying down from Everest base camp. He recently completed a difficult challenge: climbing three mountains – Nuptse, Everest, and Lhotse – in just a few days. He reached the top of Nuptse on Saturday morning, then Everest on Sunday, and Lhotse on Monday.

Cool says it was a good time to attempt this because, for the first time in many years, there were ropes already fixed on all three mountains to help climbers. He believes future climbers will try to climb these mountains without ropes or extra oxygen.

Sixty years after the first climb of Everest, people are remembering the first climbers, Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay. Cool was asked to think about what climbing might be like in another sixty years. He mentioned Ueli Steck, a Swiss climber who had to stop his attempt to climb Everest after a disagreement with Sherpa people at Camp 2. Steck planned to climb Everest and Lhotse quickly, without using ropes, and was very well prepared.

Simone Moro, Steck’s climbing partner, rescued a climber using a helicopter at a very high altitude of 7,800 metres. This shows that helicopter rescues are becoming more common on Everest. In the future, there might be a helipad on Everest to help tourists.

However, increasing tourism is causing problems for the local environment and the Sherpa people. Mountain expert Alton Byers says that climate change and tourism are putting a lot of stress on the area. Glaciers are melting, meaning there is less water for drinking, farming, and for the many new hotels being built.

A new survey in 33 countries shows that people often have incorrect ideas about important facts in their society.

In Britain, people believe the richest 1% own 59% of the country’s wealth, but the real number is 23%. In the US, people think 33% of the population are immigrants, but it’s actually 14%. Brazilians believe the average age is 56, while it’s 31. And Russians think 31% of their politicians are women, but it’s only 14%.

The survey also found mistakes in other estimates. In Britain, people thought 43% of 25-34 year olds live with their parents, but the real number is 14%. In India, people believed 60% of the country has internet access, but only 19% do.

There are several reasons for these errors. People struggle with numbers and sometimes misunderstand questions. For example, people often overestimate how many people don’t follow a religion – they think it’s 37% on average, but it’s actually 18%. This is because they may think about people who actively practice a religion, not just those who identify with one.

People also use quick thinking and rely on easily available information, even if it’s not completely accurate. For example, they might overestimate rural populations based on how much land is rural, rather than how many people live there.

Many people are aware that tigers in India, orangutans in Indonesia, and pandas are in danger of disappearing. However, scientists now worry that the loss of less well-known creatures, like ladybirds, could be an even bigger problem for nature.

We may be entering a new geological age called the Anthropocene, where humans have the biggest impact on the environment. This is because of climate change, fewer animals, a growing human population, and species dying out quickly.

A report called the Living Planet Index (LPI) in 2014 showed that the number of vertebrate animals (animals with backbones) has fallen by 52% in the last forty years. Biodiversity – the variety of life on Earth – has reached a dangerous low. Freshwater species have declined by 76% in the same period.

Scientists are particularly concerned about creatures that provide important “ecosystem services”. For example, bees and other insects pollinate around three-quarters of the world’s crops. Worms help create healthy soil, and bats control mosquitoes and reduce diseases like malaria. Losing these services has a real cost – a study in North America showed that declining bat populations caused over $22 billion in lost agricultural production.

Dr. Nick Isaac, an ecologist, explains that the loss of common species will affect people more than the loss of rare ones, because we rely on common species more. His research shows that insects and other small creatures in Britain are declining as quickly as larger animals, which could have “serious consequences” for humans. It’s not just about species disappearing completely, but also about the numbers within those species decreasing.

The appointment of Helena Costa as manager of Clermont Foot 63, a French football club, was a historic moment. She became the first woman to manage a professional men’s team in the top two divisions of a European league. Some people thought the club was only doing this for publicity, as Clermont Foot 63 was not a very successful team, ranking 14th out of 20. However, many welcomed the decision.

Véronique Soulier, representing the club’s supporters, said she was surprised but happy with the news. She believes having a woman in charge is a good thing. Costa, 36, is from Portugal and has a degree in sports science. She used to find talented players for Celtic in Scotland. She has also coached both men’s and women’s teams, including the Qatar women’s team and the Iranian women’s national side.

Clermont Foot 63’s president, Claude Michy, is known for making surprising announcements. Last year, he said the team had signed Lionel Messi – but it was a different player with the same name. France’s women’s minister, Najat Vallaud-Belkacem, praised the club for giving a woman the opportunity.

Carolina Morace, an Italian coach who previously managed a men’s team, hopes Costa’s appointment will become normal. She had a difficult experience when she coached a men’s team in Italy, as the club owner didn’t respect her decisions. She now works as a lawyer and sports commentator.

Raymond Domenech, a former French national team manager, supports the decision, saying women are capable of managing men’s teams.

Loneliness is becoming a major issue in Britain. Research shows the UK is the loneliest country in Europe, with people having fewer close friends and neighbours than in other EU countries. Many British people don’t have anyone to help them in a crisis. Studies also show loneliness is very harmful to health, even more so than obesity for older people, and can be as dangerous as living in poverty.

Surprisingly, loneliness is also a problem for young adults. A study in 2010 found that people aged 18-34 were more likely to feel lonely and depressed than those over 55. While there is support for older people, young adults often can’t access the same services. This is concerning because loneliness can lead to stress, depression, anxiety, and even suicide. It can both cause and be caused by mental health problems.

Social media can be both helpful and harmful. It’s good for keeping in touch with people far away, but it can make us feel worse if we compare our lives to others online. Experts suggest that instead of trying to solve loneliness with apps or meditation, it’s better to find ways to spend time with people. 

Using technology to *meet* new people can be helpful, and online communities can offer support. For example, one young mother found a helpful online forum for parents when she felt isolated after having a baby. Helplines like Samaritans and Get Connected can also help people who are feeling lonely.

It can also help to talk to your employer about how you’re feeling. One man who suffered from stress-related depression found that being open with his colleagues made it easier to return to work after time off. Simple things like chatting

A new computer system that helps with autopsies is being used in hospitals across Europe. Its inventor believes this technology could make it impossible to commit a ‘perfect murder’.

The system, called ‘Virtopsy’, was developed by scientists at the University of Zurich. Instead of using traditional methods with scalpels, doctors can now examine a body using 3-D images on computer screens.

Michael Thali, the director of the Institute for Forensic Medicine in Zurich and one of the inventors, says Virtopsy could greatly improve criminal investigations. He believes it can find all the evidence needed to solve a crime.

Virtopsy uses powerful imaging technologies like MRI and CT scans, combined with surface scans of the body. These are all part of a system called a ‘Virtobot’. It can find injuries, like damage to tissues or blows, that are difficult to see in a traditional autopsy. It can also detect things like air pockets, heart attacks, and even cancer.

Richard Dirndorfer, who helped develop Virtopsy and is an expert in DNA analysis, thinks it could eventually replace traditional autopsies. He compares it to how DNA analysis replaced older methods of blood testing.

The computer images allow doctors to see inside the body in great detail. It has already helped find injuries and fractures that were missed during traditional autopsies. For now, doctors want to use Virtopsy alongside traditional autopsies to improve investigations.

Dominic Wichmann, a doctor at Hamburg’s University Hospital, says Virtopsy will help forensic scientists plan autopsies more efficiently. Scientists from around the world have travelled to Switzerland to learn about this new method.

In Iceland, there are rules about what names children can have. You can choose from a list of approved Icelandic names like Aagot, Arney, or Ásfríður. But you cannot name your daughter Harriet.

A British couple, Tristan and Kristin Cardew, are having problems with their daughter Harriet’s passport. The Icelandic National Registry will not renew it because “Harriet” is not an approved Icelandic name. Their son, Duncan, also has a name that isn’t approved, so they have used the names “Stúlka” (Girl) and “Drengur” (Boy) on his passport until now. However, the authorities are now enforcing the naming rules strictly.

The family, from Kópavogur, almost missed their holiday to France. They had to ask the British embassy for a temporary UK passport so they could travel.

In Iceland, most surnames show who your father or mother is. For example, Jón Einarsson’s children might be Ólafur Jónsson and Sigríður Jónsdóttir. 

When a child is born in Iceland, the parents must register the name with the National Registry within six months. The name must be on a list of approved names, or the parents need permission from the Icelandic Naming Committee. There are about 1,853 approved names for girls and 1,712 for boys.

The Naming Committee receives around 100 requests each year and rejects about half. The rules, made in 1996, are meant to protect the Icelandic language and traditions. Names must be able to use Icelandic grammar and fit within the Icelandic alphabet of 32

Google has mapped many places around the world, including mountains, oceans, rainforests, and even North Korea. However, it has not focused much on the Arctic, a very cold and difficult place to reach.

Now, Google is starting a project to map the Arctic, which could greatly improve maps of this area that have been made for hundreds of years. The company hopes this will help people understand life in the Arctic, where the ground is frozen (permafrost).

A small Google team travelled to Iqaluit, a town in northern Canada, with warm clothes, computers, and a special camera that weighs 18kg. With the help of a local Inuit mapping expert, they spent four days walking around and taking pictures. This will allow people in Iqaluit to be seen on Google’s Street View, just like people in many other cities. Street View will be available in July 2013.

Aaron Brindle, the project leader, explained that many maps don’t show places in the north accurately. Unlike cities where Google uses cars with cameras, the team in Iqaluit had to walk because of snow and ice. They even walked along a dangerous path called the “Road to Nowhere,” despite warnings about polar bears. 

The team also found that many locals were very interested in the project and followed them around! The mayor of Iqaluit said this reminded him of explorers who first came to the area centuries ago.

Across Europe, governments are trying to find ways to reduce unemployment. However, in some of the most affected areas of the EU, joblessness is still increasing.

In Italy, the mayor of a small town called Elmas is trying a new idea. Valter Piscedda believes he has found a way to help people in his town find work, but some people think it’s more of an acceptance that there are no jobs locally. He wants to pay unemployed residents to move to other European countries to look for work.

The town council will pay for ten unemployed people to have English lessons and buy a cheap plane ticket. They can then search for jobs elsewhere in Europe. Mayor Piscedda explained that many young people come to him every day, feeling hopeless about finding work. Some want help finding a job in Elmas, but others have given up and want to gain experience abroad. He wants to help those who want to leave.

Sardinia, where Elmas is located, has high unemployment rates. In early 2014, 17.7% of people were out of work, and over 54% of those under 25 had no jobs.

The “Now I’m leaving” program will give up to €12,000 to people aged 18 to 50 who have been unemployed for at least three years and lived in Elmas. They don’t need a university degree, but their yearly income must be less than €15,000.

Some people are concerned that this program will encourage educated young people to leave Italy. However, Mayor Piscedda believes they may return in the future with valuable skills and experience.

Cities face many dangers from nature, like volcanoes, hurricanes, and earthquakes. But two common, slower threats are water and sand. If the world became colder, ice would also be a major danger, as glaciers can destroy cities. In 2013, a wall of melting ice damaged homes in Ochre Beach, Canada, but this was unusual.

More commonly, melting ice is causing sea levels to rise. Venice, Italy, used to flood ten times a year, but now floods around 100 times a year. The city is also sinking due to changes in the land underneath it. Other cities like Ho Chi Minh City in Vietnam and Jakarta in Indonesia are also sinking, with Jakarta sinking as much as 20cm each year. Jakarta has pumped out a lot of groundwater, causing the land to dry and sink.

Some cities are trying to solve these problems. Venice has plans for protection, and Ho Chi Minh City and Jakarta are taking action. However, Miami in the USA doesn’t accept it has a serious problem. Miami is low-lying, experiences more storms, and is built on limestone that absorbs water, causing flooding and pollution. It may become impossible to live there in the future.

In the Maldives, people are leaving islands because of rising sea levels. The capital, Malé, has built a sea wall, but it needs sea levels to stop rising to be safe.

Rainfall also threatens cities. Detroit in the USA had a huge amount of rain in one morning, overwhelming its old drainage system. The city is struggling to fix this problem.

Many young adults are now living with their parents for longer, and it’s becoming common. Around one in five young adults stay at home until they are at least 26, and many don’t pay any rent or bills. This is happening because of a problem with housing – there aren’t enough affordable homes.

The number of young adults living at home varies depending on where they live. It’s higher in London, where housing is most expensive, and lower in the East Midlands. A recent study showed that about 20% of young adults don’t contribute to household costs.

It’s difficult for young people to save for a home because wages are low and rents are very high. Half of renters can’t save anything for a deposit, and many can only save a small amount each month. Although mortgages have low interest rates, people need a large deposit to get one.

Because of this, more young adults are returning to their family homes to save money. Almost a third of those living at home are saving for a deposit, but another 30% aren’t saving at all.

One survey found that many parents don’t mind their children living at home for longer, as it might help them buy a house eventually. Some young adults help with groceries or housework instead of paying rent.

Experts say that older generations have created the housing problem, and young people shouldn’t be blamed for living at home. Young people’s incomes have fallen since 2008, while rents and car insurance have increased. It’s also harder for young people to get a mortgage.

David Bowie, who sadly died from cancer, continued to surprise people with his work until the very end. His last album, Blackstar, was released on his 69th birthday in January 2016 and showed he still had a talent for creating exciting and unusual music.

Throughout the 1970s, Bowie led the way in music and fashion. He started as a performer doing mime and cabaret, then became a singer-songwriter. He pioneered glam-rock, then moved into electronic music after living in Berlin. He was known for constantly changing his style and sound, driven by a strong curiosity.

David Robert Jones was born in south London. When he was seven, his family moved to Kent, where he showed he was good at singing and playing the recorder. He later studied art, music and design. When he was 12, his mother bought him a saxophone, an instrument he would use often in his music.

At 15, David formed his first band, the Kon-rads. He decided to go solo because he wanted to be different. He changed his name to Bowie to avoid being confused with another musician named Davy Jones.

Bowie’s first album, simply titled *David Bowie*, came out in 1967. In 1969, he released *Space Oddity*, which became his first big hit, timed to coincide with the Apollo 11 moon landing.

At Addis Ababa airport, visitors see pictures of teff, a tiny, nutritious grain. Signs advertise it as a naturally gluten-free food.

Ethiopia is a poor country with food security problems, but it is the original home of teff. This grain is becoming popular in health food shops in Europe and America. Teff seeds are small and full of calcium, iron, and protein. Because it doesn’t contain gluten, it can be used instead of wheat flour to make bread, pasta, and other foods. Like quinoa, teff is a healthy grain with potential for good sales in Western countries.

In Ethiopia, teff is very important. Around 6.3 million farmers grow it on over 20% of the country’s farmland. It’s ground into flour to make injera, a flatbread that is a key part of Ethiopian meals and ceremonies. People share injera as a sign of friendship, in a tradition called gursha.

For many years, teff was not well known outside of Ethiopian communities. However, more people are now looking for traditional and healthy foods, which is helping teff become more popular. Some people call teff Ethiopia’s “second gift to the world,” after coffee.

Sophie Kebede, a businesswoman from London, was surprised to learn how healthy teff is. She grew up eating injera in Ethiopia and didn’t realize how valuable teff would become.

However, increased demand for grains like teff doesn’t always help poor farmers. In Bolivia and Peru, the popularity of quinoa has led to higher prices and even food shortages for local people.

David Cameron, Barack Obama and Pamela Anderson have not taken part in the Ice Bucket Challenge. However, George W Bush, Benedict Cumberbatch and Stephen Hawking have. The challenge raised over $100 million for a US charity helping people with motor neurone disease, and £4.5 million for a similar charity in the UK, as well as money for charities in Hong Kong and Australia. But, quickly after this success, some people began to criticize it.

Some people said celebrities were only doing it to show off, while others complained that it was a waste of water or that people were having fun without donating money. Environmental groups and animal rights groups also criticized the challenge. The US charity, ALS Association, was criticized for paying its leaders high salaries.

The Ice Bucket Challenge involves someone talking about the charity on video, then having a bucket of ice water poured over their head. They then nominate three other people to do the same, or to donate money. 

It started in the US in July, and appeared on TV on July 15th. The ALS Association tried to legally protect the name “Ice Bucket Challenge”, but stopped after criticism. They said they understood people’s concerns. They have not yet responded to criticism about their spending.

The timing of the challenge was unfortunate, as it happened during World Water Week, when people were meeting to discuss the world’s water problems. The charity WaterAid asked people to use recycled water or seawater for the challenge.

Douglas Graham, from the UK’s MND Association, said the criticism was expected, but they were very grateful for the money raised. The money will help people with a serious disease that has no cure and kills five people every day in the

Dan Sullivan was late for a breakfast meeting with a journalist because the police stopped him while he was riding his motorcycle. He says he works too much and often forgets important things like dinner dates and gifts.

Like many people in Silicon Valley, the 27-year-old finance worker decided to create a business to solve this problem. He started BetterBoyfriend.me, a service that sends a gift to girlfriends or wives every month for around $70.

Sullivan has been testing the service for a while and has about 350 customers. These customers are mostly his friends who work in successful companies like Apple, Google, and Facebook. Their girlfriends have been receiving gifts for the past year.

Each month, the customers choose a gift from seven options, such as chocolate or tea. The gift is sent to the boyfriend without any branding or labels. 

Sullivan tested his idea by using Facebook ads and found that many people had the same problem. He said, “BetterBoyfriend found a real need.”

This wasn’t his first idea. He initially thought about a service where people could share dogs, as he noticed many wealthy people seemed unhappy while walking them. However, he realized dogs are only useful for a short time each day.

Another company, InvisibleBoyfriend, creates a virtual boyfriend who can text and talk to users whenever they want. The founder, Kyle Tabor, started it to help people avoid unwanted attention, but many users have become emotionally attached to their virtual partners.

Both Sullivan and Tabor were surprised by the connections their customers made with their services. Sullivan now sees himself as a relationship advisor for the boyfriends.

Scientists have created a special mirror that sends heat away from buildings and into space. They hope it can replace air-conditioning systems and save energy.

Currently, air conditioning uses about 15% of the energy in buildings in the US. Researchers believe this new mirror could reduce or even remove the need for air conditioning in some buildings, like offices and shopping centres.

Tests at Stanford University in California showed the mirror cooled down better than other surfaces in sunlight. A black surface got 60°C hotter, and aluminium got 40°C hotter, but the mirror was 5°C cooler than the air around it.

Shanhui Fan, the scientist who led the project, explained that covering a roof with this mirror could save a lot of electricity. Calculations suggest it could completely remove the need for air conditioning in certain situations.

Buildings get hot from several sources: heating systems, cooking, warm air coming inside, and sunlight. The Stanford mirror reflects 97% of sunlight. More importantly, it releases heat as infrared light, which easily passes through the atmosphere and goes into space.

To cool something down, you need a way to get rid of the heat. This is called a ‘heat sink’. The mirror uses space itself as a heat sink, as it is much colder than the building.

The mirror is very thin, made of layers of silver, silicon dioxide, and hafnium oxide. The silicon dioxide releases heat as infrared light, which then goes into space because the atmosphere doesn’t block it. The mirror is only about two thousandths of a millimetre thick.

A new, low-cost light could greatly improve lives in Africa and India by replacing dangerous kerosene lamps. The light works using gravity – a 10kg bag of rocks is lifted and slowly lowered, powering an LED light for half an hour. British designer Patrick Hunt created the light, but he struggled to get funding from banks or investors. They thought his idea was too risky.

He then used a crowdfunding website called Indiegogo to raise money from the public. Within five days, he reached his initial goal of £36,200, and within 40 days, he raised an amazing £400,000. 

Indiegogo is a new way for people with ideas to get money. Unlike traditional funding, it doesn’t require proving your idea to a bank. Instead, people donate money directly to projects they believe in. In return for donations, Hunt offered supporters their own gravity light.

Danae Ringelmann, who co-founded Indiegogo, believes this is a fairer way to fund ideas. She says it allows people to prove their idea is good by getting support from customers. Even if an idea doesn’t get fully funded, it’s useful to find out quickly if people are interested.

Indiegogo now raises around $2 million each week for new businesses. It recently expanded to the UK and Europe, with Britain becoming its third largest market.

JMW Turner, a famous British painter, will be on the new £20 note. This happened after a vote by people across the country.

It’s the first time a British banknote will feature an artist. Mark Carney, the governor of the Bank of England, asked the public to suggest famous people from the past who deserved to be on the money.

Turner, who was well-known for painting seascapes, was chosen from a list of over 590 people, including painters, sculptors, and actors. Around 30,000 people suggested names. A group of experts then made a shortlist of five people.

The final five were Barbara Hepworth, Charlie Chaplin, Josiah Wedgwood, William Hogarth, and Turner. They were chosen because of their important contributions to art and British society, and because they are still remembered today.

The announcement was made at the Turner Contemporary gallery, a place Turner often stayed when he visited Margate. Mark Carney and artist Tracey Emin, who grew up in Margate, made the announcement together.

Carney explained that it was important to involve the public in the decision. He said banknotes can be like art that people carry with them. He also said that money shows a country’s history and culture. He believes Turner was the most important British artist ever.

Tracey Emin said that choosing Turner shows Britain values creativity and art.

For almost 100 years, police and intelligence agencies have used lie detectors to try and find criminals or spies. These machines, called polygraphs, are often shown in films with people getting nervous while connected to them. However, this technology may soon become outdated.

Researchers in Britain and the Netherlands have developed a new method that is more accurate. Tests show it works successfully over 70% of the time, and it could be used by police around the world in the next ten years. 

Unlike polygraphs which look for signs like sweating or changes in breathing, this new method monitors full-body movements to detect guilt. Polygraphs are commonly used in the US for criminal cases and security checks, but are less popular in Europe. Many scientists and legal experts doubt how reliable they are. The new method has performed better in tests.

The idea is that people who lie tend to fidget more. The researchers use a special suit with 17 sensors that track movement in 23 joints up to 120 times per second. 

Ross Anderson, a professor at Cambridge University, explains that interviewers usually only detect lies about 55% of the time. Polygraphs can improve this to around 60%, but they can be misused and people may be anxious when taking them. The new method has already shown over 70% accuracy, and researchers believe they can improve it further, with some tests reaching over 80%. 

Anderson says that the research is important, especially after a US report on torture by the CIA. He points out that torture is not a reliable way to get accurate information and that this new method offers a better, scientifically proven alternative.

Rebecka Singerer was tired of being told to choose a sweeter drink because the beer she wanted was “too dark and too strong.” She believes women should be able to drink what they like. 

So, she joined FemAle, a group of women in Gothenburg, Sweden, to create the country’s first beer made by women. Their beer, called “We Can Do It,” is a pale ale now available in stores across Sweden. The label features a design inspired by Rosie the Riveter, a famous image representing women’s strength and working power from World War II.

Elin Carlsson, 25, who founded FemAle and works at a Volvo factory, explains that “We Can Do It” isn’t just for women, but is made by women for everyone to enjoy. She says it’s about equality and proving they can brew a great beer.

FemAle is challenging old ideas in the beer industry. They noticed that large companies like Carlsberg have tried for years to sell beer to women by making drinks that are lighter and sweeter, but these attempts haven’t been successful.

FemAle takes a different approach. They host tasting events only for women, so people can try different types of beer and learn what they like. They want to encourage more women to get involved in the beer world, and invite everyone – mothers, sisters, and friends – to join them.

Donald Trump made a surprising admission while speaking to supporters. He said that if he doesn’t win the presidential election, nothing else matters. He was speaking at a campaign event in South Carolina, even though he was already leading in the polls. He joked about wanting to choose the election date, saying he’d like it to be the following Tuesday. 

Trump needs strong support from his followers to win the Republican nomination and then the general election in November. He often switches between moments of doubt and confident, strong statements. He has become known as a “winner,” and this idea is central to his campaign.

Some people are surprised that Trump is doing so well, especially after several controversial statements. Traditionally, such statements would have ended a political career. He angered people when he questioned the heroism of John McCain, a Vietnam veteran who was captured by the enemy. He also argued with Megyn Kelly, a presenter on Fox News, after she asked him difficult questions.

Trump has also been criticized for insulting Mexican immigrants, defending the rough treatment of a protester, seemingly making fun of a journalist’s disability, and wrongly accusing Muslim Americans after the 9/11 attacks. 

He claims the media exaggerates these incidents and calls many journalists “scum,” but he refuses to apologize for anything he said. Some believe his supporters will eventually become tired of his attacks, especially on minorities. Recent polls show his support among Republicans has dropped slightly, but he still leads.

Other politicians question Trump’s political beliefs. One former rival said Trump is only interested in himself and doesn’t fit neatly into traditional political categories like conservative or liberal.

A long time ago, films about a galaxy far, far away became very popular. These films showed battles in space, robots, and a fast spaceship called the Millennium Falcon. This was in 1977, but interest in Star Wars is still strong today. There are new films planned, including one about Han Solo and another featuring Darth Vader.

Paul Dergarabedian, a film expert, says fans are always excited for new Star Wars information like posters and trailers. He believes no other film series creates so much passion.

In 2012, Disney bought Lucasfilm, the company that makes Star Wars. Disney announced three new films (Episodes VII, VIII, and IX) and other spin-off films to be released over time. The first spin-off film, Rogue One, will be released in 2016. It tells the story of a rebel mission to steal plans for the Death Star, a powerful weapon from the first film. There are rumours that Darth Vader will also appear in Rogue One.

A second spin-off film about Han Solo is planned for release in May 2018. Episode VII, titled Star Wars: The Force Awakens, will be released in December 2015, followed by Episode VIII in 2017.

Disney is using a similar strategy to Marvel Studios, which they also own. They are creating a large “universe” of connected films and characters. Disney has also made all six original Star Wars films available online to build excitement for the new films.

In 2010, Srinagar’s old city was a dangerous place, and police needed protection when they entered. It was a centre for groups wanting independence for Kashmir, and there were violent protests where over 100 people died.

Now, the city is much safer and attracts many tourists. People now enjoy barbecued meat and traditional food in the same streets. The Nowhatta mosque, once a place of conflict, is now part of a tour showing the area’s history and culture. Houseboats on Dal Lake are fully booked, and visitors take photos in the beautiful gardens. Ski resorts nearby were also popular with tourists.

In 2002, only 27,000 tourists visited Kashmir, because of violence. In 2012, almost one million people visited, including over 23,000 from outside India. However, very few of these were from the UK, because the British government warns people about safety risks.

Omar Abdullah, the local leader, has asked the UK government to change its advice, but they have refused. He explained that travel insurance is often cancelled if people visit Kashmir because of the warning. The last known attack on foreign tourists was in 1995, when six people were kidnapped.

Abdullah argues that it is unfair to warn people against visiting Kashmir when other dangerous places are not subject to the same advice. He points out that British citizens have died in other countries, like Spain and the USA, but people still travel there.

James Hamblin, a writer for The Atlantic magazine, decided to stop showering as often to see what would happen to his body. He used less soap and shampoo to understand if we clean ourselves too much.

He found that many people who stop using so much soap discover the same thing: when we try to clean our skin with soap, our skin tries to fix itself by making more oil. This can make us want to clean it again, creating a cycle.

Showering removes natural oils and good bacteria from our skin. While many people think this is good, it can actually dry out skin and cause it to feel tight. Our skin needs these bacteria to stay healthy. Soap washes them away, and when they grow back, they can sometimes cause body odour. 

Hamblin discovered that if you stop showering and using soap for a while, your skin adjusts. It finds a natural balance, produces less oil, and the good bacteria can grow again. He realised that our bodies are good at taking care of themselves. Doctors believe using less soap can even help with skin problems like acne and eczema.

Reducing showers also helps the environment. The average shower uses a lot of water – 65 litres each time. This is clean water that is wasted when it goes down the drain with soap. With droughts becoming more common, especially in places like California, clean water is becoming very valuable. Also, all the plastic bottles from body wash create environmental problems.

Moses King, 48, has been living with HIV for many years. While he receives medicine to help him stay healthy and has dealt with the stigma associated with the illness, he struggled to provide enough food for his family of six. As a farmer, he grew some vegetables and rice, but meat and fish – important for protein – were too expensive. He explained they survived, but lacked the nutrients they needed.

Pate K Chon, a counsellor working with people with HIV, had an idea. She had seen a film about fish farming in Thailand and thought it could help people in Liberia. She believed it could provide both jobs and a reliable source of protein. Chon, who was diagnosed with HIV in 1992, started building a fish farm.

She met John Sheehy, who helped raise money for the project. The farm, located near Liberia’s capital, Monrovia, began as a small operation. Sheehy learned about fish farming through online courses and by talking to other fish farmers in Africa. 

The project grew into Grow2Feed Liberia Fish Farm, now with 12 tanks. When full, each tank will hold 5,000 fish, providing up to 200,000 fish each year. This will help around 1,200 people, including Moses King and his family, most of whom have HIV.

The farm also uses waste from the fish tanks to grow crops, providing even more food and income for the community, which includes 503 women, 206 men, and 346 children. People who live near the farm work there, and in return, they receive fish to eat and sell

For 85 years, Pluto appeared as a blurry grey area on maps of the solar system. But on July 15th, scientists saw Pluto clearly for the first time. They discovered large mountain ranges made of water ice, as big as the Alps or the Rocky Mountains.

These amazing pictures came from the New Horizons spacecraft, which travelled 4 billion miles. The mission has been planned for almost ten years. Alan Stern, who led the mission, said the images were a great success for the team. 

One surprising discovery was mountains in the Kuiper Belt – a distant, icy area of the solar system where Pluto is located. John Spencer, a scientist on the mission, said the mountains are about 11,000 feet high and many miles wide. 

The pictures showed Pluto’s surface had no craters, suggesting it has been recently changed by geological activity. This could include ice volcanoes or geysers that send ice into the air.

Although Pluto was once considered the ninth planet, it is now called a “dwarf planet.” NASA showed pictures of the sun and the eight planets before revealing the new images of Pluto.

Scientists believe the mountains are made of water ice, with a thin layer of other ices like methane and nitrogen. Water ice is strong enough to form mountains, while methane and nitrogen are too soft. The mountains are thought to be quite new, forming less than 100 million years ago. This suggests Pluto is still changing.

The images are very detailed – if the spacecraft was over London, it could see the runways at Heathrow airport! It takes hours for New Horizons to send back each picture, and 16 months to send all the data.

Roger McKinlay, who used to lead the Royal Institute of Navigation, has written an article saying we depend too much on GPS technology. He believes this could be making our natural ability to find our way worse. He says if we don’t practice these skills, we will lose them as we use smartphones more and more.

McKinlay thinks a lot of money needs to be invested to make navigation systems reliable enough for things like self-driving cars. Until then, he suggests we need more research into navigation and schools should teach map reading and finding directions as important life skills.

In 2015, Ofcom reported that 66% of adults in the UK had a smartphone, compared to 39% in 2012. This means GPS is now very common. However, McKinlay warns us not to rely completely on devices for navigation, saying it’s a skill you can lose if you don’t use it.

A study in 2009 supports this idea. Neuroscientist Dr Hugo Spiers studied London taxi drivers and found that retired drivers did worse on navigation tests than those still working. This showed their skills decreased when they stopped using their knowledge of the city.

Dr Spiers also warns about the dangers of relying on GPS, pointing out that it can lead people into dangerous situations. In 2010, a driver in Spain died after following a satnav into a reservoir. He says while the risk to our brains isn’t fully known, there is a real danger in trusting these devices completely.

The start of the year can be a difficult time at work. It feels like a long time until the next holiday, and it’s dark in the mornings and evenings. If you dislike your job, you might start looking for a new one.

But before you apply for jobs, think about other options. We asked five people with unusual jobs about their pay, the worst parts of their work, and what they enjoy.

1. Dog-food taster
The job: Testing dog food to make sure it’s good quality.
What it involves: Philip Wells, a taster for Lily’s Kitchen, opens samples of dog and cat food, smells it, and tastes it. He says taste is important to make sure all the ingredients are balanced.
Salary: Around £20,000 to start, but an experienced person can earn £50,000 or more.
Worst part: Meeting deadlines. Wells admits he likes the food, which is made with ingredients safe for humans. He doesn’t like the smell of some cheaper pet foods.

However, the local council in Tarifa has approved plans to build a large tourist complex with 1,400 hotel rooms and 350 apartments next to the beach.

This decision has caused protests from environmental groups, who say the building will damage the natural environment and harm protected animals. The council says the project is necessary because many people in the town of Tarifa are unemployed – around 2,600 people – and Spain is facing a serious economic crisis.

Some councillors believe tourism is the only solution, as traditional jobs like fishing are disappearing. Sebastián Galindo, a local councillor, explained that the new complex will meet environmental standards and will be at least 200 metres from the beach, as required by law.

However, opponents argue that Spain already has many empty homes and that the plan favours wealthy people over migrant workers who helped build the country. Surfers are also worried that the buildings will block the wind, which is important for their sport. They don’t think the resort will attract typical holidaymakers.

Tarifa is located at the southern tip of Spain, between Africa and Europe, and is an important area for migrating animals. Groups like Greenpeace and the World Wide Fund for Nature are campaigning to save the beach, comparing the building plans to damaging a historic landmark. They are also concerned that the resort could be built on top of undiscovered Roman ruins and will affect the nearby Alcornocales National Park and areas where rare bats live.

Scientists have created a detailed map of the brain showing how the meanings of words are organised. This “atlas of the brain” uses colours to show how words and ideas are grouped together in different areas of the brain.

Jack Gallant, a neuroscientist at the University of California, Berkeley, explained that the goal was to create a map showing how the brain understands the meaning of words.

The atlas shows that no single area of the brain stores just one word or idea. Instead, each area is linked to several related words, and each word activates many different areas. These connections create networks that represent the meaning of words – for example, words like “life” and “love”, or “death” and “taxes”. 

Researchers who weren’t involved in the study have praised the atlas, saying it shows how brain imaging technology is improving our understanding of the brain. They believe it could be important for medical advances.

Alexander Huth, the lead author of the study, suggests this technology could one day be used to understand what someone is hearing, reading, or even thinking. This could help people who can’t speak due to conditions like motor neurone disease or locked-in syndrome to communicate using a computer.

To create the atlas, scientists recorded brain activity while people listened to stories from a US radio show called The Moth Radio Hour. They then linked the words in the stories to the activity in the brain, identifying around 50,000 to 80,000 small areas across the brain that responded to different words.

A nasal spray containing oxytocin, often called the ‘love hormone’, might help children with autism improve their social skills, according to US researchers. Brain scans of children with autism showed that a single dose of oxytocin improved how their brains reacted to facial expressions. This could make social interactions feel easier and more enjoyable for them.

The researchers believe that oxytocin, used with existing therapies, could help people with autism cope better in social situations. Kevin Pelphrey, from Yale University, explained that over time, this could lead to more natural social behaviour, including increased interest in others, more eye contact, and better conversation skills.

Autism is a condition that affects how people develop, and it impacts over one in 100 people. It causes difficulties with social interaction and communication, and currently, there is no established cure. Researchers are studying oxytocin because it is important for building relationships and trust. However, previous studies have had mixed results – one recent study showed no clear benefits for young people using the chemical.

Pelphrey suggests that oxytocin might help the brain learn during social interactions, and it would work best alongside therapies that encourage social engagement. He believes the study shows oxytocin affects the brain and could enhance the effects of behavioural treatments.

The scientists scanned the brains of 17 young people aged eight to 16 with autism using a technique called functional MRI. They looked at images of cars and human eyes showing different emotions. The scans were taken 45 minutes after the participants used a nasal spray containing either oxytocin or a placebo (a substance with no effect).

Cathal Redmond was disappointed with photos he took underwater while swimming off the coast of Greece. The pictures were unclear, and he realised he didn’t have enough time to set up the shots while holding his breath. He wanted to be able to easily capture images of fish in their natural habitat.

This led him to invent the Express Dive – a device that stores air and allows people to swim underwater for up to two minutes. It’s designed to be better than snorkelling, which has limited reach, and easier than scuba diving, which requires heavy and expensive equipment. The first version of the device looks like a combination of a scuba mouthpiece and a water bottle.

Redmond, 27, explains he wanted to help people do more underwater than just quickly holding their breath. He enjoyed a scuba diving course in 2006, but found all the equipment – fins, weights, wetsuit, and air tank – heavy and difficult to manage. He felt it was too complicated to simply decide to go for a swim.

The Express Dive works by using a fan to pull air into a mouthpiece. This air is then compressed and stored in a tank. A light on the tank shows when it’s full. When the user dives, the air is released through the mouthpiece. A display shows how much air is left, changing from green to red as the air runs out. It takes about two minutes to fill the device with enough air for a two-minute dive.

Redmond’s biggest challenge was making the device small enough to hold comfortably in the mouth. The electrical parts are protected from the water and can be charged wirelessly, like many mobile phones.

Other companies, including Amazon, eBay, Google, and Ikea, have also been criticized for paying little or no tax in the UK. However, surveys show that Starbucks’ reputation has been most damaged by the controversy.

Every year, about 1.3 billion tonnes of food – a third of all food produced – is wasted. This includes 45% of fruit and vegetables, 35% of fish, 30% of cereals, and 20% of both dairy and meat. Meanwhile, 795 million people suffer from hunger.

Laws in France, which make supermarkets give unsold food to charities, have highlighted the problem of food waste. The UN says reducing food waste is a major challenge to ensuring everyone has enough to eat. We will need to increase food production by 60% by 2050 to feed the growing world population, but reducing waste could make this easier.

The way food waste happens differs between countries. In developing countries, food is often lost because of poor storage, transport, or equipment. In wealthier countries, food is often wasted because people buy too much or shops reject food that doesn’t look perfect. 

People in developed countries throw away 30-40% of the food they buy, while in poorer countries, this is only 5-16%. In Europe and North America, each person wastes 95-115kg of edible food every year. In Africa and Asia, this is only 6-11kg.

Goodfellow says it’s strange to see bankers receive large bonuses. He wonders if he contributed more to his industry than they did to theirs. He’s also upset that people don’t see him as an inspiration for inventors. He created something that made billions of pounds, but he received very little money for it. He asks, “Why would anyone follow my example if they only earned £10 for a great success?”

For years, people have argued about who should be known as the “inventor of the ATM.” In 2005, John Shepherd-Barron received an award for his work on cash machines. However, the UK government now says it was Goodfellow who first invented the ATM, so his place in history is now secure.

In the 1960s, Goodfellow was an engineer and was asked to find a way for customers to get cash from banks on Saturdays. He says it’s not enough to just tell teenagers to go to bed earlier. Our bodies have a natural sleep clock. Light tells our brain when to wake up and sleep.

Countries like Burma, Bangladesh, and India can expect stronger cyclones, and other parts of Asia will have heavier summer rains. Indonesia may have less rain, but areas around the South China Sea could see more extreme rainfall during storms.

Some men experience a time in their lives when they feel unhappy and certain about death, and they might make big, unexpected changes, like buying an expensive car. This is often called a midlife crisis. Now, scientists wonder if animals can also experience something similar.

An international team of scientists has found evidence that middle-aged chimpanzees and orangutans also experience a drop in happiness. They believe this could be the ape version of a midlife crisis. The research was published in a scientific journal called Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. It suggests that the reasons for feeling unhappy in middle age might be biological and shared with our closest relatives.

Alex Weiss, a psychologist at Edinburgh University, explained that they wanted to know if the midlife crisis is only a human problem. The team asked people who work with apes – like zookeepers – to answer questions about the animals’ moods, how much they enjoyed being with others, and how well they achieved their goals. They also asked the workers how they would feel if they lived as an ape for a week, and scored their answers.

The study included over 500 apes from zoos and research centres in several countries. There were two groups of chimpanzees and one group of orangutans from Sumatra or Borneo. Researchers found that the apes’ happiness decreased in middle age and then increased again as they got older. Apes in captivity can live to be 50 or older. On average, the chimpanzees were least happy at around 28 or 29 years old, and the orangutans at 35 years old.

They asked people who work with the apes questions about how the apes felt. The questions were about their mood, how much they enjoyed being with others, and how well they could do things.

More than 500 apes were in the study. The scientists found that apes felt most unhappy when they were around 27 to 35 years old. This is about the same age when humans often have a midlife crisis. After this age, the apes seemed happier again.

Some scientists are not sure if apes can really have a midlife crisis. They say it is hard to know how an ape feels. 

But other scientists think this study can help us understand why some men feel unhappy in middle age. They believe that humans, chimpanzees, and orangutans might share similar feelings when they get older. They want to learn more about what makes these animals – and people – feel this way.

He also thinks the Mars One team is too optimistic, as they are trying to complete the $6 billion mission without enough help. He believes it is unlikely to happen.

According to the plan, Mars One will first send equipment to Mars in 2018 and 2020, and then cargo in 2022. The first people would arrive in 2025, and more would follow every two years. These people would live on Mars permanently and would not return to Earth.

PRISM lets the NSA collect information such as search history, emails, file transfers, and live chats. The document says this information is collected directly from the companies’ servers. However, all the companies contacted said they did not know about this program.

The law allows the NSA to monitor people outside the US, and Americans who communicate with people outside the US.

The town of Kiruna in northern Sweden is facing a very unusual problem: it needs to move. This is because of a large iron-ore mine that is growing under the town, and could cause buildings to collapse.

The town was built in 1900 because of the mine, which has made Kiruna rich. Now, the mine threatens to destroy the town. The mining company can either stop digging, which would cause job losses, or the town has to move to a safer location.

Kiruna is located far north, inside the Arctic Circle, where winters are very cold and dark. The mine produces most of the iron used in Europe – enough to build over six Eiffel Towers every day. Demand for the iron is still increasing.

In 2004, the mining company warned that digging would soon cause cracks in buildings. Now, ten years later, cracks are appearing and getting closer to homes and businesses.

Residents have been worried for years, and it’s been hard for them to make plans for the future, like buying a house or starting a family.

These devices allowed the rats to work together on simple tasks to get a reward, like a drink of water. In one test, the scientists connected the brains of two rats using the internet. One rat was in North Carolina, USA, and the other was in Natal, Brazil – thousands of miles apart.

The research was led by Miguel Nicolelis, who has previously developed devices that help people who cannot move to control computers and robotic arms using their thoughts. He believes this new work could allow many brains to connect and share information. “We have created a direct connection between brains,” Nicolelis said. “We are creating an organic computer.”

The scientists first showed that rats could share information by connecting their brains with tiny electrodes – small electrical connections. These electrodes reached the part of the brain that controls movement.

The rats were trained to press a lever when a light shone above it. When they pressed the lever correctly, they received water. To test if they could share brain information, the rats were placed in separate rooms. Only one room had a light and a lever. When the first rat pressed the lever, its brain activity was sent to the second rat’s brain. The second rat then correctly pressed its lever 70% of the time.

Interestingly, the communication worked both ways. If the second rat failed to press the lever, the first rat didn’t get its reward

The big British summer music festivals, like Glastonbury, may not last much longer, according to Harvey Goldsmith, a famous music promoter and manager.

Goldsmith has worked with many of the world’s most famous musicians, including The Who, The Rolling Stones, Queen, Madonna, Bob Dylan, and Luciano Pavarotti. He believes the main problem is that there aren’t enough new, popular bands to replace the older ones.

He said festivals were most popular about two years ago. Now, there are too many festivals and not enough famous bands to perform at them. This is a serious issue for the music industry. We are not creating a new generation of headlining acts like The Rolling Stones, Muse, or even Arctic Monkeys.

In 2014, there were around 900 music festivals in the UK between May and September, and Goldsmith doesn’t think they can all continue. He expects to see more festivals that offer other things besides music, like poetry, books, or magic shows. These smaller festivals will offer something different, instead of large crowds with limited facilities.

Goldsmith also said that the way people listen to music has changed. People don’t often listen to full albums anymore. But many rock bands became successful by releasing albums – it took them several albums to become really good. Young people today don’t want to wait.

Goldsmith, 69, is currently working with Robin de Levita, who produced the musical *Tommy* by The Who, on a new theatre in Wembley, London. The first stage show based on *The Hunger Games* books and films will be performed there in June 2016.

Many people we know use e-cigarettes, but it’s not clear if vaping is still becoming more popular. Recent data suggests that vaping might be decreasing among smokers and people who recently quit smoking – and these groups make up most vapers. This is important news for e-cigarette companies, who have invested a lot of money in this technology hoping it would continue to grow.

In 2014, the health charity Action on Smoking and Health (ASH) reported that 2.1 million adults in Britain used e-cigarettes, which don’t use tobacco and create vapour instead of smoke. This was three times the number of users in 2012 (700,000).

However, research from the Smoking Toolkit Study shows that vaping may be losing appeal. Vaping among smokers and ex-smokers increased until the end of 2013, when 22% were vaping. But in 2014, this number stopped rising and then fell to 19% by the end of the year. Professor Robert West, who collects this data, says this decrease is significant.

E-cigarette companies focus on smokers because most vapers (seven out of ten) are also smokers. Very few people who have never smoked (around 1%) have tried vaping. Also, fewer smokers are now using e-cigarettes *while* continuing to smoke. Professor West notes they’ve only been studying vaping for a short time, but haven’t seen a large increase in long-term ex-smokers or never-smokers taking it up. Vaping rates may not change much, but currently, they don’t seem to be growing

After landing back on Earth from a record-breaking mission in space, astronaut Scott Kelly said that looking at Himalayan lakes, doing spacewalks, and following the US presidential campaign helped him stay mentally healthy during his 340 days in space. He said the mission felt very long, longer than his previous trips. Sometimes, he admitted, he felt a little crazy.

Kelly and Russian astronaut Mikhail Kornienko spent almost a year on the International Space Station (ISS) to study how space affects the human body. They looked at the effects of weightlessness, radiation, and living in a small space. NASA believes this research is important for future missions to Mars.

Kelly said the biggest difficulty was the length of the mission, and he felt more pain when he returned to Earth’s gravity than after shorter flights. He and his twin brother, Mark, who is also a retired astronaut, have been having physical and mental tests for the past year. These tests will continue to help NASA understand how the body deals with the challenges of space travel.

Kelly said that despite the discomfort of returning to gravity, he was amazed to be back on Earth. When the capsule landed in Kazakhstan, he smelled fresh air mixed with the scent of the spacecraft. He realized how significant the mission was – 340 days on a huge space station that weighs a million pounds and is the size of a football field. The ISS uses solar power and was built by an international team.

Junior Smart understands a lot about gangs. He is 36 years old and his life has two main parts. When he was a teenager, after his mother died, he joined a gang in south London. It helped him when he was feeling lonely.

He says the gang became his new friends. At first, it was just fun, but then it became more serious and about earning money. They started committing crimes. After leaving college, he found a job and worked as a DJ. However, he continued to make money illegally with the gang.

He was eventually arrested for serious drug crimes and sent to prison for 12 years. He says the first night in prison made him realize how wrong his life had been. He had been living two different lives – one with his friends and another with their enemies. He spent a long time trying to change his life.

Now, Junior Smart leads a team of 12 people and six volunteers. They help young criminals and gang members leave crime. Most of the team used to be criminals themselves, like Smart. Some are still in prison but are allowed out during the day to help. They work with the police, probation officers, and charities to help people who feel scared and trapped in London’s violent gangs.

Smart started this work while he was in prison. He noticed that many prisoners kept returning to crime after being released. He realized they knew what they needed to change, but the prison system only focused on the crime they had committed, not the reasons behind it.

He remembers one prisoner who needed £300 a week to pay for drugs, and stole to get the money. Even though the man had a drug problem, it wasn’t addressed.

The Welsh Assembly voted for this new system. It means hospitals can use organs for transplant unless the person had registered to opt out. The vote was 43 to 8, although some groups, including religious organizations, were against it. They worried it could upset grieving families or go against their beliefs.

The Welsh Health Minister, Mark Drakeford, said this was good news for the 226 people in Wales who are waiting for organ transplants. He said Wales is leading the way in increasing organ donation and giving hope to those in need.

A major reason people don’t donate organs is because families don’t know what their loved one wanted. The new law aims to make people’s wishes clearer. If families know the person wanted to donate, they are more likely to agree.

Some people are against the new law, fearing hospitals might not respect the wishes of the deceased or their families. However, the government promises to protect those wishes. Families will still have the right to say no to organ donation.

Wales has a shortage of organs for people who need them. About one person dies each week while waiting for a transplant. Around a third of people in Wales are registered as organ donors, but surveys show over two-thirds would be happy to donate.

John Lewis, a department store, has released its Christmas advert for 2015, which features a lonely old man living on the moon. The advert is expected to be very popular and mark the start of Christmas shopping for many people.

The store hopes to raise a lot of money for the charity Age UK, which helps older people. John Lewis also wants its staff and customers to volunteer with Age UK to help elderly people who may be alone during the holidays.

The company has spent £7 million on the campaign, including the TV advert, a smartphone game, and special products like glow-in-the-dark pyjamas. They have also decorated 11 of their stores to look like the surface of the moon.

The advert tells the story of a young girl named Lily who sees the old man on the moon through her telescope. She tries to send him letters and messages, and finally sends him a telescope attached to balloons. This allows them to connect.

The company has already given 20 million yen back to over 10,000 customers, and the total amount they will refund is expected to reach 110 million yen.

He explains that authors and musicians often struggle for years before they can earn money from their work, and illegal downloading takes that away from them. He believes if people enjoy something, they should pay for it.

Scientists have created a special mirror that sends heat away from buildings, and they hope it can replace air conditioning systems. This could greatly reduce the energy used to cool buildings like offices and shopping centres.

Currently, about 15% of the energy used in US buildings goes towards air conditioning. Researchers believe this mirror could remove the need for cooling systems in some cases.

In a test at Stanford University in California, a black roof became 60°C hotter than the air, and aluminium became 40°C hotter. However, the new mirror was 5°C cooler than the air around it. Covering a roof with this mirror could save a lot of energy, according to Shanhui Fan, a light expert at Stanford who led the project. It might even make air conditioning unnecessary.

Buildings get warm from different sources, including heating systems, cooking, warm air entering through doors and windows, and sunlight.

The Stanford mirror reflects 97% of visible light. More importantly, it acts as a thermal radiator. When it gets warm, it releases heat as infrared light, which easily passes through the atmosphere and into space.

To cool something down, you need a ‘heat sink’ – somewhere to move the unwanted heat. This sink needs to be cooler than the object you are trying to cool. For example, ice cools wine because it absorbs heat. The Stanford mirror uses space itself as a heat sink.

The mirror is made of several very thin layers. First, there’s a layer of reflective silver. Then, layers of silicon dioxide and hafnium oxide turn the mirror into a thermal radiator. When silicon dioxide heats up, it releases heat as infrared light that goes straight into space.

Scientists have made a special mirror that sends heat away from buildings and into space. This means we might not need air conditioning to keep buildings cool.

JMW Turner, a famous British painter, will be on the new 20 pound note. This decision was made after a vote by the public.

It is the first time a British artist will be featured on a banknote. Mark Carney, the governor of the Bank of England, asked people to suggest a famous British person from the past who deserved to be on the note.

Turner, known for his paintings of the sea, was chosen from a list of over 590 people. The public nominated artists, sculptors, fashion designers, photographers, film-makers and actors. Some of the other nominees were Alfred Hitchcock, Alexander McQueen and Laura Ashley. A group of experts then reduced the list to five finalists.

The final five were Barbara Hepworth, Charlie Chaplin, Josiah Wedgwood, William Hogarth and Turner. They were chosen because they all made important contributions to art and British society, and their work continues to be influential.

The announcement was made at the Turner Contemporary gallery in Margate, by Mark Carney and the artist Tracey Emin. Emin grew up in Margate.

Carney explained that it was important to involve the public in the decision. He also said that banknotes can be beautiful works of art. Emin added that choosing Turner shows that Britain values creativity.

The new 20 pound note will feature Turners self-portrait from 1799, and his famous painting, The Fighting Temeraire. This painting shows a ship from the Battle of Trafalgar in 1805. It will also include a quote by Turner – “light is therefore colour” – and his signature, taken from his will. In his will, Turner left many of his paintings to the country.

For nearly 100 years, police and intelligence agencies have used lie detectors to try and find criminals or spies. However, these machines, called polygraphs, may soon become outdated.

Scientists in Britain and the Netherlands have created a new method for detecting lies that is more successful. In tests, it worked over 70% of the time. They believe this new method could be used by police forces worldwide within ten years.

Unlike polygraphs, this new method doesn’t focus on things like facial expressions or how much someone talks. Instead, it measures full-body movement. Researchers found that people who are lying often fidget more, and this movement can show they feel guilty.

Polygraphs are commonly used in the US for criminal investigations and security checks for jobs with the FBI and CIA. However, they are less popular in Europe. Many scientists and legal experts don’t think polygraphs are reliable. The new method has shown better results in experiments.

The new system uses a special suit with 17 sensors. These sensors track movement in 23 different parts of the body up to 120 times per second. 

Ross Anderson, a professor at Cambridge University, explained that interviewers usually only detect truthfulness around 55% of the time. The new method is accurate over 70% of the time, and the team believes it can improve even further – they have already reached over 80% in some tests.

Anderson also pointed out that this research is important because of a recent report about the CIA using torture. He said torture is not only morally wrong, but also doesn’t provide reliable information. The new method offers a better way to get accurate answers.

A car that can only go 25mph, with two seats and no steering wheel or pedals, might not seem impressive. However, Google in the US surprised the car and taxi industries by showing off its newest driverless car.

This electric car is being tested near Google’s headquarters in Mountain View, California. It doesn’t have normal controls like foot pedals. Instead, you use a smartphone app to tell the car where to go, and there’s a single STOP button inside for passengers to use if they need to.

The car controls everything – steering, speed, braking, and finding the route. Google is building around 100 test cars and will test them for two years. Sergey Brin, who co-founded Google, said the car is still a prototype, but the project aims to help people who don’t have easy access to transportation. He said driving it was relaxing and enjoyable.

Google says the goal is to make roads safer. The car is made with special foam at the front and a plastic windscreen, which should make it safer for people walking nearby. The cars were built by a company in Detroit, and Google will use them to learn how to make driverless cars work best. They are not yet for sale.

One problem is that the cars need very detailed maps of the roads before they can drive on them. So far, they have maps of about 2,000 miles of roads in California, but the state has over 170,000 miles of public roads.

Google plans to allow other car companies to use this technology once it’s perfected. However, some people are worried that driverless cars could replace human taxi drivers.

Jack Gallant, a neuroscientist at the University of California, Berkeley, explained that the goal was to create a detailed map showing how the brain understands language, specifically the meanings of words.

The map doesn’t show one specific area for each word. Instead, each area of the brain is connected to several related words, and each word activates many different areas. These areas work together as networks to represent the meaning of words like ‘life’ and ‘love’, or ‘death’ and ‘taxes’.

Other researchers have called this map a major achievement, showing how brain imaging technology can help us understand how the brain works. They believe further progress could greatly improve medicine and other fields.

Alexander Huth, the lead author of the study, suggests this technology could one day be used to understand what someone is hearing, reading, or even thinking. This could help people who cannot speak due to illness to communicate through a computer.

A new study by American researchers suggests a nasal spray containing the hormone oxytocin might help children with autism feel more comfortable in social situations. Brain scans of children with autism showed that a single dose of oxytocin improved how their brains reacted to facial expressions. This could make interacting with others feel more natural and enjoyable for them.

Researchers believe oxytocin could help improve the effectiveness of existing therapies that teach people with autism how to manage social situations. Kevin Pelphrey, from Yale University, explained that over time, this could lead to more typical social behaviour, such as increased interest in interacting with others, more eye contact, and more conversation.

Autism is a condition that affects how people develop, and it impacts over one in 100 people. It causes difficulties with social interaction and communication, and currently, there is no cure.

Scientists at Yale have been studying oxytocin as a possible treatment because it is important for building relationships and trust. Previous studies have had mixed results, with one recent study showing no clear benefits. However, Pelphrey believes oxytocin might help the brain learn during social interactions, and it would work best when combined with social therapies.

In the study, researchers scanned the brains of 17 young people aged eight to 16 with autism while they looked at pictures of cars and human eyes showing different emotions. The scans were taken 45 minutes after the participants used a nasal spray containing either oxytocin or a placebo (a substance with no effect).

Oxytocin is a chemical that helps people connect with each other. The scientists looked at the brains of children with autism when they used the oxytocin spray. They found that the spray helped the brain react better when the children looked at faces. This could make it easier for them to talk to people.

The scientists tested 17 children with autism, aged 8 to 16. They gave some children the oxytocin spray and others a fake spray. Then, they looked at the children’s brains while they looked at pictures of faces and cars. The brains of the children who had the oxytocin spray worked more normally when they looked at faces.
